title: studio → pipelines: name an untitled session from its first prompt
description: From API 1.43 (contracts/README.md, Sessions: titles and naming). Written by studio's outbox in the transaction that makes a session's first succeeded run terminal, once per session, while the session's title is nobody's (title_source default or prompt) and the admin's session-names setting is not off; subject `cmd.pipeline.name` (stream CMD), Nats-Msg-Id `name:<session_id>`, job_id = the session id. pipelines only records the job and acks (the in-order consumer never waits on a model): remote calls the provider snapshot through providers.chat_retried as a task; local asks studio.runs.create for the hidden `llm-ask` run (purpose name) and takes its answer from evt.studio.run_finished. Either way it publishes evt.pipeline.named, or nothing (best-effort: any failure leaves the title, a log line only).

run_id.description: the succeeded run whose prompt is named; from API 1.91, a Magic board's naming (contracts/README.md, Magic: Names): the board id

prompt.description: the run's prompt only (its workflow's first text param as typed), <imageN> tags removed, cut to 2000 characters; never images, references or the user's name

named_by.description: the model's short name shown as `named by <named_by>` (`Qwen3.8`, a provider's title)

provider.description: remote only: the provider as it was when the command was written (kind remote, or server: on this network)
